stories.headline: Chinese oil tanker attacked near Hormuz, first since US-Iran war began
stories.summary: A Chinese-owned oil products tanker was attacked near the Strait of Hormuz, marking the first known assault on a Chinese vessel since the US-Iran conflict intensified. The Marshall Islands-flagged tanker, JV Innovation, reported a fire on its deck to nearby ships on Monday. The incident occurred on May 4, the same day US President Donald Trump launched a plan to help stranded vessels, which was suspended a day later. The attack is the first reported strike on a Chinese vessel in the region since the US-Iran conflict began. Maritime security sources confirmed the incident, which was initially reported by Chinese media outlet Caixin. The attack highlights the escalating tensions in the region and the risks faced by vessels navigating the strategic waterway. The incident is under investigation, with details of the attack and perpetrators still unclear.

stories.headline: Israel Says It Killed a Hezbollah Chief Near Beirut, Testing the Truce
stories.summary: Israel's military has confirmed killing a Hezbollah chief near Beirut, testing the fragile truce in place since April 17. The airstrike targeted Hashem Safieddine, a high-ranking official set to become the militant group's next leader. This incident follows a series of tit-for-tat attacks between Israel and Hezbollah, despite the ceasefire. Earlier, Hezbollah launched rockets toward Israeli troops in southern Lebanon, and Israel struck a target in Gaza. Hezbollah also claimed to have targeted an Israeli base near Tel Aviv with advanced missiles. The killing of Safieddine marks the first Israeli strike on the Beirut area since the ceasefire, escalating tensions between Israel and the Iran-backed militant group. The exchange of attacks threatens to destabilize the region and undermine efforts to achieve a lasting peace. Israel and Hezbollah have been engaged in a conflict that has persisted despite international calls for a ceasefire.

stories.headline: Rwandan singer dies as he was being released from prison
stories.summary: Rwandan singer Kizito Mihigo died on March 24, 2026, as he was being released from prison. He was initially sentenced in February 2015, released by presidential grace in September 2018, and rearrested on February 13, 2020. Mihigo's death in custody on February 17, 2020, was under suspicious circumstances. This incident is not the first time a Rwandan musician has faced controversy and tragic circumstances. Another musician, Simon Bikindi, was known for his patriotic songs but passed away on December 15, 2018. Meanwhile, other African musicians have also faced personal struggles, including allegations of misconduct and health issues. The death of Mihigo has likely sent shockwaves through the music community, similar to the outpouring of condolences seen when other notable musicians have passed away, such as the recent mourning in Uganda for a fallen hero.

stories.headline: Saudi Arabia will build the $490 million SAMoCA cultural mega-project in Diriyah, featuring a 45,252 m² contemporary art museum
stories.summary: Saudi Arabia is building the $490 million SAMoCA cultural mega-project in Diriyah, featuring a 45,252 m² contemporary art museum. The project is part of the $63.2 billion Diriyah megaproject in Riyadh's historic district. The museum will have a total area of 45,252 square meters, with the overall project area extending to 77,428 square meters. The SAMoCA project is a flagship initiative by the Museums Commission, aiming to transform Diriyah into a cultural hub. A construction contract worth $490 million has been awarded for the project, which will showcase contemporary art in the birthplace of the Saudi state. The museum's design and construction are expected to contribute to the growth of Diriyah's cultural and tourism sectors. The project's total built-up area will be approximately 77,428 square meters.

stories.headline: Take Two CEO Strauss Zelnick on GTA 6’s gameplay: I don’t play video games, but I have seen…
stories.summary: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick revealed he doesn't personally play video games, including the upcoming Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6). Despite this, he has seen the game in action and described it as "amazing". Zelnick emphasized that Rockstar Games, the developer of GTA 6, prioritizes quality over meeting deadlines, avoiding "crunch" periods of intense work. He compared this approach to doing homework, where preparation eliminates the need for last-minute efforts. As CEO, Zelnick focuses on overseeing the business rather than being a consumer, but he does observe others playing the game. With GTA 6 being a highly anticipated release, Zelnick's leadership will be crucial in ensuring the game's success. He has been at the helm of Take-Two since 2007 and is responsible for delivering a hit with the first new Grand Theft Auto installment in over a decade.

stories.headline: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 Announced for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S A fourth player has joined your bug hunt.
stories.summary: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 has been announced for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S, with a summer 2026 release. The game is a sequel to the 2021 title Aliens: Fireteam Elite and is developed by Cold Iron Studios and Daybreak Game Company. It will feature four-player co-op, allowing up to four players to join forces as Colonial Marines in the Aliens universe. The game will also include cross-play and Horde Mode. Players will be deployed to hostile corners of the universe to battle against Xenomorphs. The addition of a fourth player is a notable change from the previous game, enhancing the cooperative gameplay experience. Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 is expected to launch this summer on the announced platforms.

stories.headline: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV Adeptus Mechanicus Gameplay Trailer Reveals Quick, Ranged Combat Faction With Plenty of Advanced Tech Tricks Ghost in the machine.
stories.summary: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV has released a gameplay trailer for the Adeptus Mechanicus faction. The Adeptus Mechanicus is a quick, ranged-focused faction that utilizes advanced tech tricks to compete with stronger melee factions. They are a fast-paced, tech-heavy army with powerful ranged combat options and unique insight into battlefield events. The faction replaces body parts with machine components, serving the Machine God, and favors nimble long-ranged combat. Supported by advanced structures, the Adeptus Mechanicus establishes a stronghold with their expanding Noosphere Network, increasing data and optimization to boost their power. The faction's gameplay is centered around their technological advancements, making them a formidable opponent in the game. The trailer showcases their abilities and playstyle, giving players a glimpse into the faction's capabilities in Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV.

stories.headline: Filmmakers Redefine Art With MAMI's IPhone Films In telling the stories of a clandestine affair on the streets of Mumbai, divinity and humanity in Kerala, a young misfit navigating Goa's vibrant
stories.summary: Filmmakers are redefining art with iPhone films, telling stories of a clandestine affair in Mumbai, divinity and humanity in Kerala, and a young misfit in Goa. Storytelling is powerful due to its ability to evoke emotions and create connections. Neurological findings show that storytelling affects the brain, making it a valuable tool for presentations and engagement. The impact of storytelling is also seen in viral content, such as the Video Barat phenomenon in Indonesia, which reflects the country's digital identity and encourages self-reflection. Additionally, historical events like the 1953 Iran coup continue to be debated and discussed, highlighting the significance of storytelling in shaping perspectives and understanding. The use of storytelling in various forms and contexts demonstrates its enduring power and influence.

stories.headline: Millwall eye 'fairytale' in Championship play-offs Millwall head into the English Championship play-offs with their sights set on a "fairytale" return to the top-flight after 36 years, while Southampton, Middles
stories.summary: Millwall is aiming for a "fairytale" return to the top-flight English Premier League after 36 years, entering the Championship play-offs. They are joined by Southampton, Middlesbrough, and Hull, who also seek to end their shorter exiles from the Premier League. Millwall's potential promotion would mark a significant milestone, having last played in the top tier 36 years ago. The Championship play-offs will determine which team earns a spot in the Premier League for the upcoming season. Southampton, Middlesbrough, and Hull are also vying for a return to the top league, each looking to end their respective absences. The play-offs will feature these four teams competing for the final promotion spot.

stories.headline: Shakira Teases 'Dai Dai,' the Official 2026 FIFA World Cup Song: Video Shakira has been tapped for the official 2026 FIFA World Cup song called “Dai Dai” with Nigerian star Burna Boy.
stories.summary: Shakira has been selected to create the official 2026 FIFA World Cup song, titled "Dai Dai," in collaboration with Nigerian star Burna Boy. The song, set to release on May 14, is a reggaetón-tinged Afrobeats track that blends the musical styles of both artists. Shakira teased the song in a video posted on Instagram from Brazil's Maracana stadium. This is not Shakira's first time creating a World Cup song, as her hit "Waka Waka (This Time for Africa)" was the official song of the 2010 World Cup in South Africa. "Dai Dai" presumably translates to "Let's go" or "We can do it," reflecting the energetic and motivational tone of the song. The upcoming release is highly anticipated, with fans eagerly waiting to hear the full track on May 14.

stories.headline: Tokyo, Shanghai, Montreal and Orlando to host expanded Olympic Q-Series on road to LA28 It will offer athletes a decisive opportunity to secure direct quota places for LA28 shortly before the Games begin.
stories.summary: The International Olympic Committee (IOC) has confirmed that Tokyo, Shanghai, Montreal, and Orlando will host the Olympic Q-Series in an expanded format on the road to the LA28 Olympic Games. The series will offer athletes a chance to secure direct quota places for LA28 shortly before the Games begin. Qualifying events will be held in these cities for sports including 3x3 basketball, beach volleyball, BMX freestyle, climbing, and others. The Olympic Q-Series will form a central pillar of the qualification pathway for the Los Angeles 2028 Games. The events will take place in 2028, providing a decisive opportunity for athletes to qualify for the Olympics. The IOC's confirmation marks an exciting development in the lead-up to the LA28 Games, with the four host cities set to welcome athletes from around the world. The Olympic Q-Series replaces the former Olympic Qualifier Series.

stories.headline: IPL 2026: Krunal Pandya, Nicholas Pooran involved in heated on-field exchange - Watch Cricket News: Lucknow Super Giants batter Nicholas Pooran and Royal Challengers Bengaluru all-rounder Krunal Pandya were involved in a brief on-field exchange
stories.summary: Lucknow Super Giants batter Nicholas Pooran and Royal Challengers Bengaluru all-rounder Krunal Pandya were involved in a brief on-field exchange during an IPL 2026 match in Lucknow. The incident occurred when Pooran reached the non-striker end, and Krunal approached him, leading to a verbal clash. This happened after Pooran was welcomed with two bouncers by Krunal, with the second one prompting an awkward shot for a single. The exchange was brief, with the two players exchanging a few words before the game continued. The incident added to the tense atmosphere of the match, with both teams competing intensely in the IPL 2026 encounter. The encounter was a significant one, with Krunal being a crisis man for RCB and Pooran struggling with form for LSG.

stories.headline: Who will be the next Bengal chief minister? Meet Mamata Banerjee’s likely successor as assembly dissolves
stories.summary: The Bengal assembly has dissolved, ending Mamata Banerjee's 15-year tenure as chief minister. The BJP is set to form the next government and has scheduled a legislative party meeting in Kolkata on May 8 to elect a new chief minister. Suvendu Adhikari is a likely successor to the post. The 207 newly elected MLAs are expected to attend the meeting and formally elect the new chief minister. The dissolution of the assembly comes after the election results, which saw the end of Mamata Banerjee's Trinamool Congress party's dominance in the state. Banerjee had publicly refused to resign despite the election outcome, and has made allegations about EVMs, which the State Chief Electoral Officer has dismissed due to lack of specificity. The political developments have intensified tensions in the state. The BJP's meeting on May 8 is expected to mark the beginning of a new government in West Bengal.

stories.headline: Single largest party or proven numbers? Tamil Nadu revives constitutional debate
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu's 2026 Assembly election results have sparked a constitutional debate over the governor's powers in hung Assemblies. The Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) party, led by actor-turned-politician C Joseph Vijay, emerged as the single largest party with 108 seats, but fell short of the majority mark of 118. The TVK's position has raised questions about whether the single largest party or a coalition with proven numbers should be invited to form the government. The DMK and AIADMK, longtime Dravidian arch-rivals, may consider forming a coalition to keep TVK out of power, after over 50 years of not working together. The Tamil Nadu Congress has accused the Governor of favouring the BJP over the Constitution in the dispute over TVK's majority. The situation has led to intense political negotiations in the state.

stories.headline: What is zinc phosphide, the rat poison that killed a family of four in Mumbai?
stories.summary: A family of four in Mumbai's Pydhonie area died after consuming zinc phosphide, a rat poison found in a watermelon they ate. The poison, commonly used as a rodenticide, has no antidote, leaving doctors with limited treatment options. Initial reports ruled out bacterial infection, and police investigations suggest the watermelon was the source of the poisoning. However, officials note that the watermelon's thick skin makes it unlikely for the poison to seep in from the outside, sparking further investigation. Zinc phosphide was found in the family's remains and the watermelon sample, confirming the cause of death. The incident occurred last month, and police are continuing to investigate the circumstances surrounding the tragic deaths. The findings contradict earlier speculation that the deaths were caused by food items like biryani or watermelon itself, rather than the rat poison.

stories.headline: Rat poison in watermelon killed family of 4 in Mumbai, finds probe
stories.summary: A family of four in Mumbai's Bhendi Bazaar area died after consuming a watermelon laced with rat poison. Forensic tests revealed the presence of zinc phosphide, a highly toxic ingredient, in the viscera of the deceased and the watermelon sample. The Dokadia family had eaten the watermelon during a family dinner, after which they developed symptoms similar to food poisoning. The investigation, which involved 54 tests over 11 days, confirmed that the rat poison in the watermelon was the cause of their deaths. The incident occurred last month, and the forensic report was released recently, shedding light on the tragic events that led to the loss of four lives. The tests were conducted at forensic laboratories in Kalina, Mumbai.

stories.headline: CFOs are worried about geopolitics and inflation, but they’re still chasing growth
stories.summary: CFOs are managing through significant risks in 2026, including geopolitics, inflation, pricing pressure, and uncertainty about customer affordability. Despite these concerns, they remain focused on growth. A Deloitte survey of Fortune 500 CFOs found decreased optimism about the economy due to inflation, geopolitical risks, and regulation. However, investment and business activity indicate more confidence on the ground. Rising metals prices and geopolitics are key concerns for portfolios in 2026. Central banks' mixed signals and global shocks, such as the Israel-Gaza war, contribute to economic uncertainty. The new Reserve Bank governor, Michele Bullock, notes that interest rate rises are slowing the economy, but global shocks continue to impact it. CFOs are navigating these challenges while pursuing growth opportunities.

stories.headline: Canada As An Energy Superpower: Can It Unlock Its Potential?
stories.summary: Canada is poised to unlock its potential as an energy superpower, with Prime Minister Mark Carney unveiling nation-building projects to transform the country's economy. Currently, Canada's energy production is largely channeled to the United States, but evolving geopolitics may create new opportunities. To achieve its potential, Canada needs the right investment framework in place. Carney has pledged to accelerate project development and turn Canada into an "energy superpower." The country's ability to become a major energy player hinges on its ability to navigate geopolitical, economic, technological, and societal factors. With the right approach, Canada can capitalize on its vast energy resources and become a dominant force in the global energy market, reducing its reliance on a single export market and diversifying its economy. This transformation could have significant implications for Canada's economy and global influence.

stories.headline: The S&P 500 Rally Looks Broad: It Isn’t
stories.summary: The S&P 500 reached a new all-time high after a weak US ADP report and a positive ISM Manufacturing PMI release. The rally was triggered by the higher employment index and lower inflation index in the ISM data. Despite the record high, the median stock in the index is 13% below its respective high, indicating a wide gap. This disparity suggests the rally is not as broad as it appears, with some stocks lagging behind. The 2025 rally may be a prelude to a broader 2026 surge if the Fed's policy and corporate execution align with bullish expectations. The market is watching April's CPI and inflation data, as well as geopolitics, for potential impacts on the rally's continuation. A clear Fed policy and strong corporate performance are crucial for sustaining the uptrend.

stories.headline: Seeking Alpha and Forbes did not provide a 4th headline, only 3 were given
stories.summary: Seeking Alpha and Forbes published three headlines, with one article titled "Trump Vows Not To Exit Iran 'Early' — Despite Telling Congress War Was 'Terminated'" by Antonio Pequeño IV, a Forbes staff member. Seeking Alpha is a leading source of stock ideas and investment insights, featuring analysis from third-party authors, including professional and individual investors. Forbes is a global media company focusing on business, investing, and technology. The article on Trump's Iran stance contrasts with his earlier statement to Congress that the war was "terminated". Seeking Alpha provides news, data, and analysis to investors through its website and mobile apps, while Forbes offers opinion-driven content from its contributors, who are columnists rather than journalists. Both platforms aim to inform and guide investors in volatile markets.

stories.headline: India’s 2026 State Polls Power up the Modi Juggernaut, Reshape the Opposition
stories.summary: India's 2026 state polls have seen the BJP retain Assam, defeating the Congress party. The BJP also made significant gains in West Bengal, a state previously considered a stronghold of secular-liberal politics. The opposition has raised concerns over electoral manipulations and threats to the federal structure. To ensure a fair process, the Election Commission of India has deployed additional observers in West Bengal. A three-tier security arrangement is in place in the state, including armored vehicles. Polling is underway in Assam, Kerala, and Puducherry, with West Bengal and Tamil Nadu to follow. The results from all five states are expected on May 4. The elections are a test of Prime Minister Modi's political might, with the BJP seeking to expand its influence and the opposition attempting to challenge its dominance. The outcome will have significant implications for Indian politics.

stories.headline: Biden Administration Faces Criticism Over Handling of Classified Documents
stories.summary: President Biden is facing criticism over the handling of classified documents found in his former Washington office and home. Recently, a document with classified markings from his time as vice president was discovered in his "personal library" at his Wilmington, Delaware home, along with other documents found in his garage. In January, a "small number" of classified documents were also found at his Indiana home. The discoveries have sparked criticism, including from Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis, who is expected to announce his Republican presidential nomination campaign soon. Despite the controversy, a new poll shows that most Americans believe the Biden administration is handling the investigation well. The issue has raised questions about the president's handling of sensitive documents and has become a political talking point ahead of the upcoming election.

stories.headline: US Senate Passes Landmark Bill to Address Climate Change and Energy Policy
stories.summary: The US Senate has passed a landmark bill addressing climate change, tax reform, energy policy, and healthcare. The bill is considered the most aggressive climate policy to pass Congress, with provisions aimed at reducing greenhouse gas emissions. Independent analyses suggest it could lower carbon emissions by 40% below 2005 levels by 2030. The legislation sets ambitious standards for reducing emissions, making it a significant step in addressing climate change. The bill's passage is expected to have a substantial impact on Americans and the economy, with potential benefits for the environment and public health. The bill's provisions will work to reduce the nation's reliance on fossil fuels and promote cleaner energy sources, marking a significant shift in US energy policy. The bill's effects will be closely monitored in the coming years.

stories.headline: European Union Leaders Meet to Discuss Economic Growth and Migration Reform
stories.summary: European Union leaders met to discuss economic growth and migration reform. The meeting aimed to address the ongoing migration challenges facing the EU, with leaders expecting no quick solution. The issue of migrants has been a pressing concern, with many refugees and migrants being rescued by aid workers. The EU is also focusing on energy reforms, economic updates, and environmental issues. Additionally, the union is working on digital transformation efforts to define Europe's direction. The meeting is part of a series of discussions and summits, including international gatherings where the EU is represented. The EU's cooperation with its Eastern partners, including Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Moldova, and Ukraine, is also being closely monitored. The meetings and summits will shape the EU's policies and decisions on various issues, including migration, economy, and environment.

stories.headline: Trade Setup for May 8: Top 15 things to know before the opening bell Experts believe the underlying trend remains positive, supported by improving momentum indicators and the index holding above short- and medium-term moving aver
stories.summary: Experts believe the underlying trend in the market remains positive, supported by improving momentum indicators and the index holding above short- and medium-term moving averages. The Nifty managed to hold 24,000, but the banking index is seen as a key factor. The CNN Fear & Greed Index uses seven market indicators to gauge stock market movements and determine whether stocks are fairly priced. Meanwhile, the EUR USD market is being closely watched, with real-time updates, forecasts, and technical analysis available. The market is also being influenced by economic events, with experts providing insights and analysis to help investors make informed decisions. With the index showing positive signs, investors are cautiously optimistic about the market's future direction, and are looking to the banking index for further guidance.

stories.headline: Nigerian lender paid Sh15.8bn in National Bank acquisition Access Bank acquired NBK in 2025 in the quest for a larger market share, notably in the retail market, where the deal upgraded it to mid-tier status with over 1
stories.summary: Access Bank, a Nigerian lender, paid Sh15.8 billion to acquire National Bank of Kenya (NBK) in 2025. The acquisition aimed to increase Access Bank's market share, particularly in the retail market. As a result, Access Bank upgraded to mid-tier status with over 100 branches across the country. The deal was part of Access Bank's strategy to expand its presence in the market. Meanwhile, KCB took over a Sh42 billion driver's licence deal from Access Bank. Access Bank is licensed by the Central Bank of Nigeria and has been operating in Kenya since the acquisition. The bank offers various services, including bill payments and token requests. The acquisition has contributed to Access Bank's growth in the Kenyan market, enhancing its position as a major player in the financial sector. The deal was finalized in 2025.

stories.headline: Nutrien reports earnings of US$139M in Q1 Nutrien Ltd. reported net earnings of US$139 million during the first quarter, rising from US$19 million during the same period last year.
stories.summary: Nutrien Ltd. reported net earnings of US$139 million in the first quarter, a significant increase from US$19 million during the same period last year. The company's net sales rose, driven by stronger prices, with potash net sales increasing 24% to $926 million, nitrogen rising 15% to $1.01 billion, and phosphates gaining 35% to $485 million. The increase in sales and profit is attributed to the war in Iran driving up fertilizer prices. Chief Executive Ken Seitz stated that Nutrien delivered record potash sales volumes and stronger nitrogen and retail performance in the first quarter. The company's diluted net earnings per share were $0.27. The earnings report indicates a substantial improvement in Nutrien's financial performance compared to the same quarter last year.

stories.headline: Spirit Airlines passenger with dementia found dead after staff ‘abandoned’ him at airport, lawsuit says Exclusive: Alone and disoriented, 75-year-old Marcos Humberto Vindel Osorio wandered out of George Bush Intercontinental Airport and onto a busy highway, where
stories.summary: A 75-year-old Spirit Airlines passenger, Marcos Humberto Vindel Osorio, with dementia was found dead after allegedly being abandoned by staff at George Bush Intercontinental Airport in Houston. Osorio arrived at the airport on June 8, 2024, from Honduras and disappeared shortly after. His body was later found along the Eastex Freeway, several miles from the airport, where he was fatally struck by multiple vehicles. According to his family, Osorio was alone and disoriented when he wandered out of the airport. A lawsuit has been filed, claiming that Spirit Airlines staff failed to provide adequate care and supervision, leading to Osorio's death. The incident is under investigation, highlighting concerns about the treatment of vulnerable passengers, particularly those with dementia, in airline care.

stories.headline: The White House w
stories.summary: The White House has announced plans to build a new 90,000 sq ft building with a 650-person ballroom, estimated to cost $200m (£151m). This project fulfills a long-held desire of US President Donald Trump. The announcement comes after a recent security incident at the White House Correspondents Dinner, where President Trump, the first lady, and top lawmakers were evacuated due to a gunman opening fire outside the ballroom. The new building is expected to enhance security and provide additional event space. The project's details and timeline have not been fully disclosed. The White House has shared a rendering of the proposed ballroom, but further information on the construction and design process is awaited. The new facility aims to improve the White House's event hosting capabilities.

stories.headline: The Messy, Humiliating Courtroom Drama Between Elon Musk and OpenAI
stories.summary: Elon Musk testified for a second day in his civil trial against OpenAI, discussing his reaction to Microsoft's $10 billion investment in the company. Musk called the move a "bait-and-switch" in a text to OpenAI's CEO, expressing his concerns. He stated that without him, OpenAI would not exist, emphasizing his role in the company's creation. The trial revolves around the nonprofit status of OpenAI, with Musk accusing the company of paving the way for charitable exploitation. OpenAI's CEO, Sam Altman, has countered Musk's claims, leading to a heated courtroom clash between the two. The lawsuit has put OpenAI's safety record under scrutiny, with the company's leadership and financial dealings being closely examined. Musk's testimony has shed light on the complex and contentious relationship between him and OpenAI's leaders.

stories.headline: Worries about AI's risks to humanity loom over the trial pitting Musk against OpenAI's leaders
stories.summary: A US trial is underway between Elon Musk and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, with concerns over artificial intelligence's risks to humanity looming in the background. The trial centers on a business dispute, with Musk claiming OpenAI prioritizes commercial interests over public safety. Musk co-founded OpenAI as a nonprofit in 2015 but later split from the company. He alleges that OpenAI's focus on profit compromises its ability to protect humanity from AI's potential risks. OpenAI's lawyer counters that Musk sued because he didn't get his way. The trial highlights the debate over who should control AI and how to mitigate its risks, with both sides having previously found common ground on the need to protect humanity from AI's potential dangers. The case is being heard in Oakland, California.

stories.headline: Musk vs Altman: Before suing OpenAI, Musk tried to bring its leaders under Tesla
stories.summary: Elon Musk filed a lawsuit against OpenAI and its CEO, Sam Altman, accusing them of breaching a contract by prioritizing profits over the public good. Musk, who donated $38 million to OpenAI's early funding, claims the company's for-profit conversion was improper. He is seeking to unwind the conversion, remove Altman and another executive from their roles, and direct any damages to OpenAI's nonprofit arm. The lawsuit comes after Musk and OpenAI parted ways, with Musk reportedly trying to bring OpenAI leaders under Tesla's umbrella. The move is seen as an attempt to undermine OpenAI as a competitor to Musk's tech companies, including Tesla and Neuralink. Musk's lawsuit alleges that OpenAI's actions have compromised its original mission to develop AI for the public good. The case is ongoing, with Musk seeking significant changes to OpenAI's structure and leadership.
